title: Pre-Merge Readiness
description: Read-only pre-merge readiness evidence snapshot for a PR head.

protocolVersion.description: Schema protocol version for this pre-merge readiness document.

decisionAuthority.description: Declares that this document is read-only evidence for the instructions-layer decision logic, never a decision by itself.

prHeadSha.description: Commit SHA of the PR head this readiness snapshot was collected for.

now.description: Timestamp the snapshot was collected at; the reference point for every elapsed-time and staleness calculation in this report.

reviewCurrency.description: Comparison between the last posted review-watermark snapshot and current live PR activity, deciding whether cached review findings are still safe to rely on or the gate must return to E1 for a fresh review pass.

watermarkPresent.description: Whether a trusted review-watermark marker for the expected claim was found on the PR.

watermark.description: The most recent trusted review-watermark marker's recorded fields, or empty/"none" placeholders when watermarkPresent is false.

agentId.description: Agent identifier recorded on the watermark marker.

claimId.description: Claim identifier the watermark marker was posted under.

headSha.description: PR head commit SHA recorded at watermark time.

maxActivityUpdatedAt.description: Latest comment/review/thread activity timestamp recorded at watermark time, or "none".

totalItemCount.description: Total comment, review, and thread count recorded at watermark time.

latestCiCompletedAt.description: Latest completed CI check timestamp recorded at watermark time, or "none".

createdAt.description: GitHub creation timestamp of the watermark marker comment, or "none".

live.description: Freshly computed activity snapshot for the current PR state, compared against the watermark above.

totalItemCount.description: Current total comment, review, and thread count, after filtering out trusted operational-marker comments.

maxActivityUpdatedAt.description: Current latest comment/review/thread activity timestamp, or "none".

latestCiCompletedAt.description: Current latest completed CI check timestamp across all checks, or "none".

latestPassingCiCompletedAt.description: Current latest completed CI check timestamp restricted to pass-equivalent states, or "none".

counts.description: Current raw item counts feeding totalItemCount.

comments.description: Current count of non-operational-marker issue/PR comments.

ackOnly.description: Structural ack-only evidence: advisory-bot activity newer than the latest recognized disposition, which can explain new activity without reopening review.

advisoryBotLogins.description: Configured advisory-bot logins considered for ack-only classification.

source.description: Provenance of the advisory-bot login list: an explicit flag, an environment variable, repository config, or none configured.

dispositionsPresent.description: Whether at least one disposition comment or thread reply by a recognized disposition author was found.

latestDispositionAt.description: Timestamp of the latest recognized disposition, or "none".

items.description: Individual ack-only comments and thread replies posted after the latest disposition.

kind.description: Whether the ack-only item is a regular comment or a review-thread reply.

id.description: Identifier of the ack-only comment or thread reply.

author.description: Login of the advisory bot that posted the ack-only item.

activityAt.description: Timestamp of the ack-only item's activity, or "none".

bodyPreview.description: Truncated preview of the ack-only item's body.

effective.description: Live activity recomputed with ack-only items excluded, used to decide whether activity newer than the watermark is substantive.

maxActivityUpdatedAt.description: Latest activity timestamp after excluding ack-only items, or "none".

totalItemCount.description: Total item count after excluding ack-only items.

comparisonRoute.description: Whether the watermark still covers current activity ("proceed") or the gate must return to E1 for a fresh review pass ("return-to-e1").

comparisonReason.description: Specific reason the comparison chose comparisonRoute, e.g. missing-watermark, head-changed, newer-activity, ci-pass-drift, ack-only-post-disposition, or snapshot-current.

threads.description: Review-thread classification counts and per-thread detail consumed by the unresolved-threads merge gate.

unresolvedCount.description: Total count of review threads not marked resolved on GitHub, before gate-specific classification.

actionableCount.description: Count of unresolved threads classified as blocking the merge gate (actionable-blocking, amd-blocking, or conversation-resolve-agent/author).

awaitingReviewerCount.description: Count of unresolved threads whose latest comment is from an IDD agent or the PR author and are waiting on a human reviewer; does not block the gate.

amdBlockingCount.description: Count of unresolved threads awaiting a maintainer decision: an IDD-agent reply starting "Awaiting maintainer decision" with no later reply.

conversationResolveAgentCount.description: Count of unresolved threads blocking only because the base branch requires conversation resolution and the latest reply is from an IDD agent.

conversationResolveAuthorCount.description: Count of unresolved threads blocking only because the base branch requires conversation resolution and the latest reply is from the PR author.

classifications.description: Per-thread gate classification for every unresolved thread.

classification.description: Gate classification assigned to this unresolved thread.

unrepliedComments.description: Regular PR comments from a non-IDD-agent author with no later IDD-agent reply or recognized disposition. Feeds the F2 unreplied-comments check, not the readiness rollup.

bodyPreview.description: Truncated preview of the comment body.

reviewerStates.description: Required-review and CODEOWNER approval state derived from PR reviews, branch protection/ruleset requirements, and CODEOWNERS.

reviewDecision.description: GitHub's own aggregate review decision for the PR.

requiredApprovingReviewCount.description: Configured minimum number of approving reviews required by branch protection/ruleset.

requireCodeOwnerReview.description: Whether branch protection/ruleset requires a CODEOWNER approval.

requiresConversationResolution.description: Whether branch protection/ruleset requires all review threads to be resolved before merge.

requiredReviewerLogins.description: User logins required as reviewers by branch protection/ruleset.

requiredReviewerTeams.description: Team slugs required as reviewers by branch protection/ruleset.

codeownerUserLogins.description: User logins matched as CODEOWNERS for the PR's changed files.

codeownerTeamSlugs.description: Team slugs matched as CODEOWNERS for the PR's changed files.

unmatchedCodeownerFiles.description: Changed files that matched no CODEOWNERS rule.

latestByAuthor.description: Each reviewer's latest gating review, one entry per author.

state.description: Reviewer's latest review state (e.g. APPROVED, CHANGES_REQUESTED).

submittedAt.description: Timestamp the reviewer's latest review was submitted.

isHuman.description: Whether the reviewer is not a recognized advisory bot.

isAdvisoryBot.description: Whether the reviewer is a recognized advisory bot.

isCodeowner.description: Whether the reviewer is an eligible CODEOWNER for the PR's changed files.

isRequiredReviewer.description: Whether the reviewer is named as a required reviewer by branch protection/ruleset.

humanApprovedCount.description: Count of distinct non-bot reviewers whose latest review state is APPROVED.

requiredApprovalsSatisfied.description: Whether the required-approving-review-count and any per-reviewer requirements are all satisfied.

codeownerApprovalSatisfied.description: Whether CODEOWNER approval is satisfied: not required, no explicit CODEOWNERS match, a human codeowner approved, or GitHub's aggregate decision stands in because individual reviews could not be classified.

codeownerSelfApproval.description: Diagnostic for the case where the PR author is also the sole eligible CODEOWNER for the changed files, which can otherwise deadlock the CODEOWNER-approval gate.

status.description: Overall self-approval deadlock status, escalating from not applicable through a resolvable or unverifiable bypass to a genuine deadlock.

reason.description: Specific reason behind status, e.g. why a bypass, deadlock, or ambiguity was found.

prAuthorLogin.description: PR author's login, normalized to lowercase.

directCodeownerUserLogins.description: All direct-user CODEOWNERS logins matched for the changed files, before eligibility filtering.

codeownerTeamSlugs.description: Team-based CODEOWNERS slugs matched for the changed files.

requireCodeOwnerReview.description: Whether CODEOWNER review is required by branch protection/ruleset (mirrors reviewerStates.requireCodeOwnerReview).

codeownerApprovalSatisfied.description: Whether CODEOWNER approval is currently satisfied (mirrors reviewerStates.codeownerApprovalSatisfied).

bypassDetected.description: Whether an applicable pull-request bypass actor (classic protection or ruleset) is configured for the current viewer.

bypassMode.description: Kind of pull-request bypass detected across the relevant rulesets, or none when no applicable bypass is configured.

currentUserCanBypass.description: GitHub-reported bypass eligibility for the current viewer across the relevant rulesets.

rulesetBypassUnreadable.description: True when a codeowner-requiring ruleset's detail read was masked-404 unreadable, so bypassDetected could not rule out an actual configured bypass. Diagnostic only: never flips status to clear by itself, but downgrades an otherwise-certain deadlock to possible_deadlock.

prAuthorIsSoleEligibleCodeowner.description: True only when the PR author is the sole eligible direct-user codeowner (no team codeowners, no email codeowners, at least one eligible direct-user codeowner, and every eligible direct-user codeowner equals the author). This is the narrow self-CODEOWNER-deadlock topology fact; a 'clear' status/reason alone does not imply it, because the bypass-detected and non-author-owner-available branches can both report 'clear' without checking this condition.

codeownerEligibilityUnreadable.description: True when at least one direct-user codeowner's collaborator-permission lookup failed for a reason other than "not a collaborator" (403/5xx/network/timeout). When true, prAuthorIsSoleEligibleCodeowner is forced to false regardless of what the (possibly incomplete) eligible set otherwise computed, because a transient lookup failure for a genuinely eligible non-author codeowner must never be silently treated the same as that codeowner having no write access at all.

humanChangesRequestedCount.description: Count of non-bot reviewers whose latest review state is CHANGES_REQUESTED.

blockingChangesRequestedLogins.description: Logins of non-bot reviewers whose latest review state is CHANGES_REQUESTED.

advisoryWait.description: Copilot advisory-review wait-state evaluation, deciding whether the E14/F2 gate must keep waiting, request a fresh review, or is satisfied.

outcome.description: E14/F2 advisory-wait state machine's current outcome, evaluated from Copilot's pending/reviewed state, same-head markers, and the elapsed/settled windows below.

f3Outcome.description: F3-specific advisory-wait outcome, which treats a settled (no-longer-pending) Copilot request as SATISFIED even when outcome above is not.

lastCopilotCommit.description: Commit SHA of the latest Copilot review found, or empty when none exists.

copilotPending.description: Whether Copilot currently has an outstanding review request on the PR.

copilotPendingCoversHead.description: Whether the pending Copilot review request was made for the current PR head commit.

sameHeadMarkerPresent.description: Whether a trusted advisory-wait marker recorded for the current head SHA was found.

earliestSameHeadAt.description: Timestamp of the earliest trusted same-head advisory-wait marker, or empty when none exists.

sameHeadMarkerCount.description: Count of trusted advisory-wait markers matching the current head SHA.

requestMarkerCount.description: Count of trusted advisory-wait request markers posted for this PR.

requestCap.description: Configured maximum number of advisory-wait review requests before the gate reports CAP_EXHAUSTED.

pendingWindowMinutes.description: Configured minutes to wait, once a same-head marker is present, while Copilot's review is still pending before treating the wait as satisfied.

settledWindowMinutes.description: Configured minutes to wait, once a same-head marker is present and Copilot is no longer pending, before treating the wait as satisfied.

pollIntervalMinutes.description: Configured polling interval, in minutes, for re-checking the advisory-wait state.

capExhaustedRoute.description: Configured routing once requestCap is reached: phase-specific handling, or an unconditional hold.

elapsedMinutes.description: Minutes elapsed since the earliest same-head advisory-wait marker, compared against pendingWindowMinutes/settledWindowMinutes.

copilotUnavailable.description: #1570/#1572: true when buildCopilotRecoverySummary reports state === COPILOT_UNAVAILABLE for this HEAD. Computed by the caller (pre-merge-readiness.mts); false is the unmigrated default.

copilotUnavailableWaived.description: #1570: true when copilotUnavailable is true AND a valid maintainer external-check waiver exists for the idd-advisory-convergence selector on current HEAD.

ci.description: Required-check evaluation derived from live CI check runs plus branch protection/ruleset required-check configuration.

status.description: Rollup classification of the required checks, accounting for missing checks and the source-pinned downgrade of an otherwise-passing result.

noRequiredChecksConfigured.description: Whether no required checks are configured for the base branch. Never true when protection/ruleset reads were unreadable or a required check is source-pinned.

protectionReadsUnreadable.description: #1377: true when a branch-protection or ruleset read threw a masked-403-as-404 that was not trusted as genuinely empty (ciGate.trustEmptyProtectionReads). noRequiredChecksConfigured is always false when this is true.

presentRunConclusion.description: Conclusion across all present check runs, with waiver-covered runs counted as passing; used as the F2 fallback when no required checks are configured.

requiredCheckCount.description: Count of required check names resolved from branch protection/ruleset.

generatedRequiredCheckCount.description: Count of required checks that have at least one matching run reported for the current head.

requiredChecksGenerated.description: Whether every required check name has a matching run reported for the current head (no missing required checks).

requiredChecksPassing.description: Whether at least one required check is configured and the overall status is success.

requiredCheckNames.description: Names of every required check resolved from branch protection/ruleset.

missingRequiredCheckNames.description: Required check names with no matching run reported for the current head.

discardedNonPassingRequiredChecks.description: #1745: same-name/type/workflowName required-check instances discarded by the latest-per-producer dedup while the dedup-selected representative for that group is pass-equivalent -- surfaces the exact PR #1741 divergence, where a CANCELLED idd-advisory-convergence instance was masked by a same-name SUCCESS instance even though GitHub's own statusCheckRollup.state disagreed. Empty (never omitted) when no such discarded sibling exists.

type.description: Discarded check's producer-identity type (e.g. check-run or status-context).

workflowName.description: Actions workflow name the discarded check ran under, when applicable.

selectedState.description: State of the same-name/type/workflow instance the dedup selected as latest instead of this discarded one.

selectedCompletedAt.description: Completion timestamp of the selected instance, or null when not yet completed.

discardedState.description: Non-passing state of this discarded sibling instance.

discardedCompletedAt.description: Completion timestamp of this discarded instance, or null when not yet completed.

sourcePinnedRequiredCheckNames.description: #1689: required check names whose green state was downgraded to `unknown` (via `status` above) because their ruleset/classic-protection entry carries an `app_id`/`integration_id` (source-pinned) and the `ciGate.trustSourcePinnedRequiredChecks` opt-in was not set. Producer verification itself is not implemented (no GitHub App identity is fetched for a live check-run anywhere in this codebase); the opt-in is a human-authorized trust decision, not a runtime check. Lets a caller's blocker detail name the source-pinned cause explicitly instead of a generic "CI is not all-passing" message. Empty (never omitted) when no such downgrade occurred.

sourcePinnedUnresolved.description: #1689: true when the downgrade above fired at least partly because of a pinned source that could not be attributed to any check name (a ruleset `workflows` rule, or a pinned entry with no `context`/`name`/`check`). Distinct from `sourcePinnedRequiredCheckNames` being empty, which alone is ambiguous between "no pinning" and "pinning exists but is unnamed." An unresolvable pinned source is never covered by the `ciGate.trustSourcePinnedRequiredChecks` opt-in, even when a separate, named-and-pinned entry also exists on the same required-check set.

checks.description: Every check run reported for the current head, normalized with required/waiver status.

completedAt.description: Check's completion timestamp, or empty when not yet completed.

required.description: Whether this check name is one of the resolved required checks.

coveredByWaiver.description: Present and true only when a valid, policy-configured external-check waiver rewrote this non-passing check to pass-equivalent for gate purposes.

claim.description: Claim-ownership validation comparing this session's expected claim/agent identifiers to the claim issue's currently active claim.

expectedClaimId.description: Claim id this session expects to still be active, as recorded at claim time.

expectedAgentId.description: Agent id this session expects to still be active, as recorded at claim time.

activeClaimPresent.description: Whether any active claim was resolved from the claim issue's comment stream.

activeClaim.description: Fields of the currently active claim, or empty strings when none is present.

supersedes.description: Prior claim id this active claim superseded, or empty for a fresh claim.

branch.description: Implementation branch recorded on the active claim.

createdAt.description: GitHub creation timestamp of the active claim's latest valid claimed-by comment.

matchesExpectedClaim.description: Whether the active claim's agent id, claim id, and (when supplied) activation nonce all match the expected values.

claimLost.description: Whether ownership no longer matches the expected claim; the inverse of matchesExpectedClaim.

reason.description: Why claim-ownership resolution matched or failed.

dispositionEvidence.description: E7 disposition-completeness evidence: whether every reviewer comment and unresolved thread has a recorded IDD-agent disposition, gating a return to E1 when evidence is missing.

route.description: Whether disposition evidence is complete ("proceed") or the gate must return to E1 ("return-to-e1").

reason.description: Whether disposition evidence is complete, or evidence is missing.

blockingCount.description: Total count of outstanding items (missing regular comments plus missing threads) blocking the disposition-evidence gate.

missingRegularCommentCount.description: Count of regular comments with no recognized IDD-agent disposition.

missingThreadCount.description: Count of unresolved or undispositioned review threads.

soleCauseAckOnlyPostDisposition.description: Advisory-only: true when at least one blocking item exists and every blocking item is a resolved thread blocking solely due to post-disposition advisory-bot ack-only activity. Never changes route by itself.

soleCauseInPlaceEditOnly.description: Advisory-only, a stricter subset of soleCauseAckOnlyPostDisposition: also true only when every qualifying ack-only reply is an in-place edit of pre-existing content rather than a new post-disposition comment. Never changes route by itself.

missingRegularComments.description: Regular comments still missing a recognized IDD-agent disposition.

bodyPreview.description: Truncated preview of the comment body.

hint.description: Diagnostic-only note, present only when applicable: names the exact required disposition phrase or literal prefix an IDD-agent reply attempt was close to but missed -- either a recognized advisory non-review notice with a wrong-phrase reply (#1833), or any missing comment with a plain-text reply attempt that never satisfies the required bold **Accepted**/**Rejected** prefix (#2249).

isResolved.description: Whether the thread is marked resolved on GitHub.

reason.description: Why this thread is still outstanding, distinguishing an incomplete comment page from a missing or stale disposition.

ackOnlyPostDisposition.description: Advisory-only: true when this resolved thread blocks solely because of post-disposition advisory-bot ack-only activity newer than the review-currency snapshot boundary.

inPlaceEditOnly.description: Advisory-only, narrower than ackOnlyPostDisposition: true only when every qualifying reply is an in-place edit of content that already existed at or before the thread's disposition.

waiverEvidence.description: External-check waiver markers grouped by validity outcome, evaluated against the current PR head, active claim, trusted-actor policy, and the configured waivable-check surface.

valid.description: Waivers that passed every validity check and cover a policy-configured waivable check.

authorLogin.description: Login of the waiver's author, normalized to lowercase.

reason.description: Maintainer-authored justification recorded on the waiver.

createdAt.description: Waiver comment's own creation timestamp (#2034), or 'none' when unparseable; the moment a generic waivable check's waiver became genuinely active, used to gate coveredByWaiver on a fresh post-waiver check run.

expired.description: Waivers whose expiry has passed, or whose validity window exceeded the configured maximum.

authorLogin.description: Login of the waiver's author, normalized to lowercase.

wrongHead.description: Waivers bound to a PR head commit other than the current head.

authorLogin.description: Login of the waiver's author, normalized to lowercase.

waiverHeadSha.description: PR head commit SHA recorded on the waiver, which does not match the current head.

wrongClaim.description: Waivers bound to a claim id other than the currently active claim.

authorLogin.description: Login of the waiver's author, normalized to lowercase.

waiverClaimId.description: Claim id recorded on the waiver, which does not match the active claim.

unauthorized.description: Waivers posted by an author who is not a trusted marker actor.

authorLogin.description: Login of the waiver's author, normalized to lowercase.

malformed.description: Comments that matched the external-check-waiver marker prefix but could not be parsed.

authorLogin.description: Login of the comment's author, normalized to lowercase.

bodyPreview.description: Truncated preview of the unparseable comment body.

notConfigured.description: Waivers that passed every validity check but name a check the policy never declared waivable; excluded from valid and never fold a check into requiredChecksPassing.

authorLogin.description: Login of the waiver's author, normalized to lowercase.

modeDisabled.description: #2046: waivers that passed every validity and waivable-selector check but the policy's ciGate.externalCheckWaivers.mode is not maintainer-authorized; excluded from valid and never fold a check into requiredChecksPassing, mirroring advisory-convergence.mts's own mode guard.

authorLogin.description: Login of the waiver's author, normalized to lowercase.

advisoryConvergenceWaiverPrecondition.description: #2021: deadline/terminal precondition gating whether a posted idd-advisory-convergence waiver counts toward ci.coveredByWaiver -- mirrors advisory-convergence.mts's own deadline clock (a 24h deadline anchored on the current HEAD commit's own committedDate) and its terminal Copilot-unavailability escape hatch, so this evidence collector never reports a check as covered before that gate itself would call the waiver waived.

checkSelector.description: The idd-advisory-convergence check selector this precondition gates.

deadlineMinutes.description: Configured advisory convergence deadline in minutes (advisoryWait.convergenceDeadline, default 1440 = 24h).

headCommittedAt.description: ISO timestamp of the current HEAD commit itself, or the literal 'none' when unavailable.

elapsedMinutes.description: Whole minutes elapsed from headCommittedAt to now, or null when headCommittedAt is invalid or absent.

deadlinePassed.description: True when elapsedMinutes is known and has reached deadlineMinutes.

terminalUnavailable.description: The caller-supplied #1572 terminal Copilot-unavailability verdict (same value as advisoryWait.copilotUnavailable).

open.description: True when deadlinePassed or terminalUnavailable -- the precondition that must hold before a posted idd-advisory-convergence waiver counts toward ci.coveredByWaiver.

secondaryQuietWindow.description: #2335: the advisoryWait.secondaryQuietWindow gate status -- once the E-phase convergence conditions are already met, requires the configured window to have elapsed since the last substantive (non-ack-only) activity before treating the review as settled. Anchored on reviewCurrency.live.effective.maxActivityUpdatedAt; stateless by design.

minutes.description: Configured secondary quiet window in whole minutes (advisoryWait.secondaryQuietWindow, default 0 = off).

anchorAt.description: ISO timestamp of the last substantive (non-ack-only) activity this window anchors on, the literal 'none' when no such activity exists, or the literal 'declined' when the #2547 secondaryBotDeclined short-circuit fired. Still the real timestamp (not 'none') when minutes is 0 but a valid activity timestamp exists.

elapsedMinutes.description: Whole minutes elapsed from anchorAt to now, or null when the window is off, declined is true (anchorAt is the literal 'declined', not a timestamp), anchorAt is otherwise invalid/absent, or now failed to parse.

elapsed.description: True when the configured window has elapsed since anchorAt -- always true when minutes is 0 (off), anchorAt is unavailable, or declined is true.

remainingMinutes.description: Whole minutes remaining until the window elapses. 0 when the window is off (minutes is 0), declined is true, or anchorAt is invalid/absent; otherwise null only when elapsedMinutes itself is null (now failed to parse).

declined.description: #2547: true when the configured secondary advisory bot has definitively declined (a rate-limit / skip-review notice, with no later genuine comment) to review the CURRENT HEAD -- the wait is skipped entirely (elapsed: true, remainingMinutes: 0) rather than requiring the full configured window.

branchCurrency.description: #1513: whether the base branch's protection or ruleset requires an up-to-date head before merge, paired with the PR's live mergeable/mergeStateStatus.

mergeStateStatus.description: Live GitHub merge-state status for the PR head, used to detect a stale head requiring an update before merge.

mergeable.description: Live GitHub mergeability value for the PR head.

requiresUpToDateHead.description: Whether the base branch's ruleset or classic protection requires the PR head to be up to date with the base branch before merge.

requiresUpToDateHeadSource.description: Provenance of requiresUpToDateHead: a confirmed ruleset or classic-protection read, an unreadable read that fails closed to true, or a genuinely readable 'no rule found'.

trustedMarkerActors.description: Configured trusted marker actor logins used to validate operational markers (claim, watermark, waiver, and related markers) for this snapshot.

trustedMarkerActorsSource.description: Provenance of trustedMarkerActors: an explicit flag, an environment variable, repository config, or none configured.

localValidationEvidence.description: #2323: the caller-precomputed resolveLocalValidationEvidence result (local-validation-evidence.mts), reported verbatim. Omitted entirely when the caller does not pass it. Purely informational -- computePreMergeReadinessBlockers has no reference to this field, so it can never remove or downgrade a required-check blocker; an unavailable required check stays a blocker regardless of this field's contents.

developmentBranchTarget.description: #2272: the caller-precomputed resolveEffectiveDevelopmentBranch result (policy-helpers.mts) paired with the live PR baseRefName, reported verbatim. Omitted entirely when the caller does not pass it. Unlike localValidationEvidence above, this DOES feed computePreMergeReadinessBlockers: an invalid/unavailable status, or a branch that differs from baseRefName, adds a development-branch-target blocker.

status.description: 'configured' (an explicit developmentBranch policy value) or 'default' (policy absent, live repository default branch used) never block; 'invalid' (malformed policy value) or 'unavailable' (policy absent and the live default branch could not be read) always block.

baseRefName.description: The PR's live base branch, read alongside the same headRefOid/baseRefName pr view fetch this report already performs.

ready.description: Strict merge-gate rollup: true only when blockers is empty. Does NOT apply the dispositionEvidence.soleCauseAckOnlyPostDisposition override (a separate flag the F2 checklist layers on top).

blockers.description: One entry per unmet F3 merge gate, in gate order; empty when ready.

gate.description: Identifier of the unmet pre-merge gate, e.g. ci, required-reviews, claim-ownership, or branch-currency.

detail.description: Human-readable explanation of why this gate is unmet.
